resources.string: Removes trackers from links. Works offline and collects nothing.
Cleans a link when you copy it. Uses an accessibility service to notice the copy.
Cleans a link when you tap it in another app. Bugged becomes the default browser and passes the link on.
Notices when you copy a link and removes its trackers. To notice a copy, it looks for Copy buttons you tap and the clipboard preview. Bugged keeps nothing it sees and has no internet access.
